candidate_notes: SQL-like implementation of the DOCX true-return-cost framework; uses actual fee recovery rows when available and the documented 60% TCS timing-loss approximation.
formula: ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund' AND mp_fee_type = 'ItemPrice' AND charged_amount_type = 'principal' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + GREATEST(0, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'shipping fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) - SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Fulfillment Fee Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'shipping fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + GREATEST(0, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'tech fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) - SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Fulfillment Fee Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'tech fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'pickup fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + GREATEST(0, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'commission' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) - SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'refund commission' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + GREATEST(0, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'closing fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) - SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'closing fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + 0.60 * ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'tcs gst' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END))
